facts.meaning: Normal nonforced bump first requests SE, then increments bump_count, stores current initial position, sets move_timer0 and bumpingtrue. Forced route skips SE only. SE failure precedes count. Creation does not move coordinates, write distance, call increase_steps or globally increment stepcount.

With legal global metadata, diving OR surfing selects distance_surfed first; else bicycle selects distance_cycled; else distance_walked. Then ice_sliding additionally writes distance_slid_on_ice using the same supplied distance. Water has precedence over bicycle. No clamp/coercion in this method; later ice/stat failure retains earlier selected-counter write.

First optional turn_generic preserves encounter indicator. If encounter_triggered true after it, skips all move/passability/touch/bump branches, then tail clears indicator if normally reached. When false, passability gate is first; ledge branch jumpForward2 optionally SE/increase_steps then returns regardless of jump success; it does not fall into bump.

At passable waterfall_crest movingdown, sets descending_waterfall=true and player.through=true and increments waterfalls_descended BEFORE attempting end-surf/ordinary movement. Later return/failure does not restore these writes. This is one exact descent counter producer, separate from FieldMoves traversal producer not received here.

After end-surf false and second turn, only if encounter indicator stillfalse: writes initial coords, logical x/y, timer0, then distance(abs dx+abs dy), then increase_steps. Thus logical coordinates/distance can be committed before leave-tile callbacks and before visual motion completes. No whole-operation rollback. Blocked four-way path first checks touch; bump created only if touch returnsfalse.

Nonzero direct jump turns dominant axis (ties vertical), validates every occupied destination through passable(d0), and returns on first denial. Success writes jump origins/coordinates/timer/peak/distance and calls increase_steps. Direct zero offset bypasses direction/passability yet starts nominal1 jump and increase_steps. Player override calls super first, then only after normal return and actual coordinate change adds Manhattan distance; a leave-tile callback failure inside super may leave coordinates changed before distance write.

facts.complete_unit: Game_Character four diagonal methods inherited by Game_Player
facts.meaning: Each first directly adjusts facing unless directionfixed, without turn_generic callback, then fixed-order can_move gate. Success writes both coordinates/initialposition/timer and increase_steps once. Failure retains any prior facing adjustment, without four-way touch/bump. None of these methods calls add_move_distance_to_stats or the player generic ledge/end-surf path; ordinary/ice distance counters not increased by this direct diagonal submission.

increase_steps resets stop_count then triggerLeaveTile. That helper triggers on_leave_tile only when old x/y/map all recorded and some position/map differs; then updates old tracking after callback normal return. It does NOT add global stepcount. Callback failure retains prior coordinate/stop changes and can prevent tracking update.

Character update returns for in_menu; otherwise updates last monotonic reference/delta and returns on delta>0.25 before movement work. Qualified update_move advances local timer and snaps coordinates. On movement completion clears timer/bumping; on jump completion clears jump fields. Then if neither active triggers on_step_taken, calculates bushdepth, marks stopped; moved_this_frame set at tail. A zero-displacement bump can therefore reach general step notification after sufficient qualified time; callback failure can prevent later flags/player chain.

Returns if moving/jumping/global forced_movement. Only moved_this_frame then: followers turn, distance events, same-position events (bitwise|= evaluates this too), then pbOnStepTaken(result). No coordinate-change gate at this stage. Earlier event/callback failure prevents later stages; general step callback may start new motion and cause this method toreturn.

Forced move route OR running map interpreter: trigger general on_step_taken(player), then return without global increment. Otherwise initializes false/nil stepcount0, increments and masks0x7FFFFFFF, captures repel_active before player callbacks, triggers on_player_step_taken then on_player_step_taken_can_transfer(shared[nil]); truthy handled[0] returns. Only otherwise and !eventTriggered&&!in_menu performs battle check. Final encounter flag clear only if reached. Counts/earlier callback effects persist on transfer/exception.

Mount alreadybicycle returns without count. Otherwise flagtrue→cycle_count+1→vehicle refresh→optional bicycle BGM cue→SE→Radar cancel. Tail failure keeps prior flag/stat. Dismount requires currentlybicycle, clears flag before refresh/map cue. Destination bike predicate missingMapMetadata false, otherwise always_bicycle OR can_bicycle OR outdoor_map. No actual rider/render/BGM execution here.
